metric.grossPitchError: abs(estimateHz - referenceHz) > 0.2 * referenceHz; jointly voiced frames only
metric.octaveClassification: gross errors within 1200*log2(1.2) cents of -1200 or +1200 cents
metric.fineError: absolute cents error on jointly voiced frames that are not gross errors
metric.consensusSampling: nearest frame after each tracker's fitted time offset, without extrapolation
